review.decision: Fix observed app regression failures without weakening contracts
review.notes: User explicitly asks to repair the app failures. Design recorded before test changes; no independent approval or commit-order claim. Preserve no-commit/no-live-window boundary. Only task-owned synthetic fixtures, isolated tmux sockets/HOME, test-scoped launchd label. Keep every advertised key combination and actual launchd readiness assertion; do not skip failed cases or substitute mocks for existing integration coverage.

cases.description: Boot-server integration excludes caller HOME/config and checks actual readiness
cases.setup: Disposable caller HOME with a synthetic tmux config marker; short private socket; actual test-scoped launchd job on macOS.
cases.action: Use isolatedTmux then start the boot server via launchd; inspect session and server environment. Retain direct/fallback tests.
cases.expected: Server starts and contains only the requested session; caller PATH reaches server, caller config marker does not; HOME/socket belong to fixture. Failure cleanup stays scoped to the test.

cases.description: Empty dispatch slug leaves a stable explicit window name/options unchanged
cases.setup: Private tmux server and disposable HOME; explicitly named window to exclude the unrelated automatic command renamer.
cases.action: Call nameDispatchWindow with empty slug; compare fixed baseline and automatic-rename option before/after. Keep title, branch and multi-pane tests.
cases.expected: No rename/options change for empty slug; regular slugs still include pane IDs and headless marker. No sleeps, retries or relaxed equality.

cases.description: Full advertised terminal-key matrix remains byte-exact through isolated native tmux
cases.setup: Private socket selected directly via TMUX_TMPDIR, disposable HOME, raw Python receiver and actual tmux binary; no wrapper shell on each client invocation.
cases.action: Send every advertised key/modifier via production sendTerminalKey with fresh binding validation, check cumulative bytes after each event and reject unknown key. Record bounded progress for diagnosis.
cases.expected: All 400+ advertised combinations remain exercised and byte-exact; count is recorded, no production transport guard bypass, no raw user input. Test cleanup restores global binary and owns only the private server.
